example.com/embedbuild embeds a js/wasm build of its own wasm package.

-- wasm/main.go --
package main

func main() {}
-- main.go --
//go:embedbuild -gzip blob/app.wasm.gz GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm example.com/embedbuild/wasm

package main

import (
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
)

//go:embed blob
var blob embed.FS

func main() {
	fs.WalkDir(blob, "blob", func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if !d.IsDir() {
			fmt.Println(p)
		}
		return nil
	})
}
